_comment: __text baseline for the binary-size CI gate (see devkit bench size check and .github/workflows/binary_size.yml). Only AOT gates are recorded: the runtime-lane gates (Gates.RUNTIME in devkit/footprint.py) are not held to a floor and are built only by `devkit bench size compare --runtime`. Measured osx-arm64, 2026-10-07, on mojo 1.2.0.dev2026092105. Regenerate after an intentional size change with: pixi run -e dev python -m devkit bench size check --update. Re-recorded for joins as one JoinChain: query_join +38,592 (+2.15%), ibis's name rules, the equality classes, verifying the tree and lowering it by position; query_cli +19,584 (+0.59%), mostly the chain's rendering; the other gates +720 to +5,200 (at most +0.29%), the chain as a DynRelation member. Deltas are against the parent commit's recorded floors, same machine and mojo.
